free_tier.stated: 20 TB space, 20 TB transfer/month, 60 domains, DirectAdmin

egress.terms: 'Transfer 20 TB' per month on the 20 TB plan (1:1 with storage). Not unlimited — this is a metered transfer allowance, and it is exactly at the client's 20 TiB archive scale. Verbatim plan row: 'Space 20TB — Transfer 20TB — $42/month'.

interface_detail: FTP/FTPS, SFTP, SCP, rsync over SSH, DirectAdmin, web delivery; 'Object Storage Beta' API
chaining: rsync target; DirectAdmin file manager; beta object API
limits_note: 1:1 transfer ratio; no root; ZFS/RAID-Z2 backing
reliability_note: Transfer cap at 1:1 is the binding constraint — a 20 TB restore consumes the entire month's allowance. Fine for backup-in, poor for serving.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'ST 600 — 20 TB storage — $42/month — Transfer 20TB — Domains 60 — Control Panel DirectAdmin'; 'ST 500 — 10 TB — $25/month — Transfer 15TB'; 'ST 400 — 4 TB — $10/month — Transfer 10TB'

price_per_tb_month: $2.10/TB/mo at 20 TB ($42). At 5 TB interpolating the 4 TB plan ($10, 10 TB transfer) → $2.50/TB/mo. Egress is metered 1:1, which is the difference from Hetzner at the same price.
